correctness.rationale: All parameter ranges and degenerate boundaries are explicit. The proof derives three conditional expectations, solves the joint covariance recurrence from the n=2 base, derives exact root cluster and leaf variances, and uses justified gamma asymptotics with a positive leading root-cluster variance coefficient. The included independent enumeration checks the joint moments over every recursive tree and edge configuration through n=7 at five exact rational parameters; finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected full 2021 probability manuscript reports root-cluster marginal laws and leaf-count laws separately and does not furnish the specific cross moment Cov(root cluster size, original-tree leaf count). The 2015 paper supplies root-cluster marginal moments only, and the 2026 root-reconstruction paper focuses on majority inference. The closest indexed result gives only the coefficient obtained by letting retention probability tend to zero, not the nonlinear all-parameter covariance or its universal correlation exponent. Exact full-parameter comparisons were made rather than solely title matches. A prior joint generating-function relation may still imply the present identity; no independent priority conclusion is asserted.

value.rationale: The cross statistic ties a global percolation component to the terminal structural population of the original recursive tree, quantities studied separately in the 2021 motivating paper. Exact positivity for every finite n>=3 and interior retention parameter together with covariance growth n^r but universal correlation decay n^-1/2 gives a nontrivial quantitative dependence/decorrelation phenomenon; it is not merely an elementary relabeling of a marginal moment. The r↓0 limit explains a known root-degree/leaf covariance without subsuming the full interior-r theorem.
